title: Social card source
description: A JSON card, or the YAML front matter plus panels of a Markdown card. Character and count limits are enforced here; per-panel line limits are listed as x-maxLines per layout. A card that passes this schema can still fail to fit at the minimum code font size, which only a real render detects.

$schema.description: Optional URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete. Ignored by the renderer.

title.description: First title line. At most 70 characters.

highlight.description: Second title line, in the accent colour. At most 70 characters.

subtitle.description: One or two sentences under the title. At most 150 characters.

insight.description: The "design note" under the panels. At most 220 characters.

issue.description: Issue number shown on the card. At most 12 characters.

layout.description: Panel arrangement. "stack": 1 to 2 panels; at most 22 lines per panel with 1 panel, 14 lines per panel with 2 panels; code font 20 to 16 px. "columns": 2 panels; at most 18 code lines per panel; code font 18 to 13 px. "grid": 3 to 4 panels; at most 12 code lines per panel; code font 16 to 12 px.

panels.description: Code panels, in order. How many depends on the layout.

then.description: "stack": 1 to 2 panels; at most 22 lines per panel with 1 panel, 14 lines per panel with 2 panels; code font 20 to 16 px.
"columns": 2 panels; at most 18 code lines per panel; code font 18 to 13 px.
"grid": 3 to 4 panels; at most 12 code lines per panel; code font 16 to 12 px.

label.description: Panel header text. Defaults to the language name. At most 45 characters.

language.description: A Shiki language id or alias, e.g. "csharp", "cs", "ts", "yaml", "jsonc".

code.description: The code. Line limit per panel depends on the layout (see x-maxLines). At most 4000 characters.

highlightLines.description: One-based line numbers to highlight; each must be within the code.

underline.description: Up to 6 exact single-line substrings of the code to underline.

verdict.description: Tick or cross badge and header tint.

notes.description: Up to 3 short bullet points under the code.
